specials: A Knight unit will always use its initiative to charge an enemy if possible and cannot be given orders instead. They will never use their initiative to evade.
bretonnia:pegasus-knights.notes:
Knights are unaffected by enemy that cause terror in combat and they don’t suffer the usual -1 Attack modifier.
**Pegasus Knights.** Pegasus Knights can fly.

specials: A single General or Hero can ride a Hippogriff. A unit that includes a Hippogriff rider causes terror in its enemies.
bretonnia:hippogriff.notes: A Hippogriff can fly, increasing its rider‘s move from 60 to 100cm, and it adds +2 Attacks to those of its rider.
